howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get expert support in four simple steps
howItWorks.step1_desc: Describe your issue with our intelligent wizard. AI helps classify and prioritize automatically.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Our engine matches you with the best consultants based on expertise, availability, and budget.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Connect via chat, video, or screen sharing. Real-time collaboration with session tracking.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Issue resolved, time recorded, timesheet approved by you, invoice created. Rate your consultant and build trust.
howItWorks.faq_subtitle: A quick answer for each of the four steps above.
howItWorks.faq_step1_q: Request — what should I include when submitting?
howItWorks.faq_step1_a: Add the module, system landscape (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP…), error codes or screenshots, and your desired timeline. Our AI wizard auto-classifies the issue and assigns priority — the more context you give, the faster the match.
howItWorks.faq_step2_q: Match — how does AI pick the right consultant?
howItWorks.faq_step2_a: AI compares every available expert with your request: module fit, certifications, language, availability and rate. You see the best candidates and pick the one you want.
howItWorks.faq_step3_q: Booking — how do I confirm and pay for a session?
howItWorks.faq_step3_a: Pick a time from the consultant's calendar and confirm. The hourly rate is agreed first, and you pay later for the hours that you approve in the timesheet. NDAs and access scopes are signed in the app before the work starts.
howItWorks.faq_step4_q: Support session — how does the live session work?
howItWorks.faq_step4_a: Join the session by secure chat, video, or screen sharing. The time is recorded and every action is logged. Afterwards the consultant submits a timesheet, and the invoice is created when you approve it.

framed.headline: Google Meet refuses to load inside another page.
framed.cause: Google Meet sets X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and frame-ancestors 'self', so browsers block it from rendering inside any embedded frame (you will see ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE).

step.0: Open this app in a real browser tab (not an embedded view), then click Join again.
step.1: When the Google Meet tab opens, sign in with the Google account that received the invite.
step.2: If you are on a managed device, your admin may need to allow meet.google.com in Chrome's site settings.

load_failed.headline: Google Meet could not be opened.
load_failed.cause: The meeting URL was rejected, the Google account has no access, or a corporate proxy/firewall is blocking meet.google.com.

step.0: Verify you are signed into the Google account that received the invite (check the avatar at meet.google.com).
step.1: Try opening the link in an incognito window to rule out an unrelated logged-in account.
step.2: Disable VPN, ad-blockers, and strict tracking-protection extensions for meet.google.com.
step.3: On corporate networks, ask IT to allow meet.google.com, *.gstatic.com and *.googleusercontent.com.
step.4: As a fallback, ask the organizer to share an alternative provider link (Jitsi/Zoom).

popup_blocked.headline: The Google Meet tab was blocked by your popup blocker.
popup_blocked.cause: Browsers require an explicit allow-list for popups on this site.

step.0: Click the popup-blocked icon in the address bar.
step.1: Choose "Always allow popups and redirects from this site".

invalid_url.headline: The Google Meet link is not valid.
invalid_url.cause: The URL is missing or does not point to meet.google.com/<code>.

step.0: Ask the organizer to resend the meeting link from Google Calendar.
step.1: A valid Meet link looks like https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij.

framed.headline: Microsoft Teams refuses to load inside another page.
framed.cause: Teams blocks framing via X-Frame-Options. Embedded views show "Refused to display in a frame" and ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.

step.0: Open this app in a real browser tab, then click Join again.
step.1: If prompted, choose "Continue on this browser" or open in the Teams desktop app.
step.2: Sign in with the work/school account that received the invite.

load_failed.headline: Microsoft Teams could not be opened.
load_failed.cause: The link expired, the account has no access, or your tenant blocks anonymous join.

step.0: Click "Continue on this browser" instead of "Open Teams app" if the desktop client is unresponsive.
step.1: Sign in with the email address the invite was sent to.
step.2: If your organization disables anonymous join, ask the organizer to add you explicitly.
step.3: Clear cookies for *.teams.microsoft.com and try again.

popup_blocked.headline: The Teams tab was blocked by your popup blocker.
popup_blocked.cause: Browsers require explicit popup permission for this site.

step.0: Allow popups for this site in the address bar.

invalid_url.headline: The Microsoft Teams link is not valid.
invalid_url.cause: The URL is missing or does not point to teams.microsoft.com.

step.0: Ask the organizer to resend the meeting link from Outlook or Teams.

framed.headline: Zoom may not launch correctly from an embedded view.
framed.cause: Zoom's join page redirects to the desktop client via a custom protocol; some browsers refuse to launch external protocols from inside an iframe.

step.0: Open this app in a real browser tab, then click Join again.
step.1: If the Zoom client does not open, click "Launch Meeting" or "Join from your browser".
step.2: Allow the Zoom protocol prompt ("Open zoommtg://…") if your browser asks.

load_failed.headline: Zoom could not be opened.
load_failed.cause: The Zoom desktop client is not installed, blocked, or the meeting requires registration.

step.0: Install the Zoom client from zoom.us/download or click "Join from your browser".
step.1: If a passcode is required, copy it from the invite.
step.2: On corporate networks, ask IT to allow *.zoom.us and *.zoomgov.com.
step.3: Try the join link in incognito to rule out a stale Zoom session.

popup_blocked.headline: The Zoom tab was blocked by your popup blocker.
popup_blocked.cause: Browsers require explicit popup permission for this site.

step.0: Allow popups for this site in the address bar, then click Join again.

invalid_url.headline: The Zoom link is not valid.
invalid_url.cause: The URL is missing or does not point to zoom.us/j/<id>.

step.0: Ask the organizer to resend the Zoom meeting link.

framed.headline: Jitsi can run embedded, but camera/mic permissions are limited.
framed.cause: Jitsi itself allows framing, however the parent page must grant camera/microphone via Permissions-Policy. Embedded views often miss that.

step.0: Open this app in a real browser tab — then Jitsi gets full camera/microphone access.
step.1: If you must stay in the embedded view, click the lock icon in the address bar and allow Camera and Microphone for this site.

load_failed.headline: Jitsi could not be opened.
load_failed.cause: The public meet.jit.si server is rate-limited or unreachable, or your network blocks WebRTC.

step.0: Refresh the page and try again — the public server occasionally throttles new rooms.
step.1: Disable VPNs and aggressive privacy extensions, then retry.
step.2: If WebRTC is blocked on your network (common on corporate VPNs), join from a different network or hotspot.

popup_blocked.headline: The Jitsi tab was blocked by your popup blocker.
popup_blocked.cause: Browsers require explicit popup permission for this site.

step.0: Allow popups for this site, then click Join again.

invalid_url.headline: The Jitsi link is not valid.
invalid_url.cause: The URL is missing or does not start with https://meet.jit.si/.

step.0: Ask the organizer to resend the meeting link.

framed.headline: This meeting may not load inside an embedded view.

step.0: Open this app in a real browser tab, then click Join again.

step.2: Ask the organizer for an alternative provider link.

um.deleted_restore: Deleted. Can be restored for {{n}} more days.

um.country_unavailable: Sign-in country is not available; networks are shortened for privacy.
um.failed_note: Failed attempts before sign-in cannot be linked to an account, so only some appear here.
um.suppressed: E-mails to this address are blocked
um.gdpr_desc: Export everything stored about this person as a JSON file (bank and payout numbers are never included). Exports are recorded.
um.suspend_desc: They are signed out now, cannot sign in, and their consultant profile leaves the directory and matching. The reason is shown in this console.
um.counts: {{a}} tickets as client · {{b}} as consultant · {{c}} bids · {{d}} payments
um.reactivate_desc: They can sign in again and return to the directory if their profile qualifies.
um.signout_desc: All their sessions end now. They can sign in again.
um.pw_desc: {{n}} gets an e-mail with a link to set a new password.
um.verify_desc: {{n}} gets a new link to confirm their e-mail address.
um.mfa_desc: Their authenticator is removed and they are signed out. Only do this after confirming who they are.
um.delete_desc: They are signed out and hidden. You can restore the account for 30 days; after that a super admin can anonymise it.
um.restore_desc: The account can sign in again.
um.anon_desc: Their e-mail, name, phone and sign-in methods are removed for good. Tickets and invoices stay, without personal details. This cannot be undone.
um.hard_desc: The account is removed and cannot be restored. Records linked to it may be removed too. Prefer Anonymise.
um.unmerge_desc: The account is reactivated and the roles it gave to the other account are removed again.
um.reason_hint: Saved in the history with your name.
um.err_self_role: You cannot change your own roles.
um.err_needs_super: Only a super admin can grant or remove admin and super admin.
um.err_reason_admin: Please give a reason for an admin role change.
um.err_last_super: The last super admin cannot be removed.
um.four_eyes_note: Granting super admin needs approval by a second super admin. A request will be created.
um.roles_hint: A person can hold several roles. Changes are recorded and super admins are alerted about admin role changes.
um.message_hint: Shown in their notifications; e-mailed if their e-mail notifications are on.
um.title: Title
um.link_invalid: Use a page on this site starting with /.
um.merge_desc: {{email}} will be suspended and linked to the account you keep. You can undo this with Unmerge.
um.merge_effect: Client/consultant roles of the merged account are added to the kept account. Tickets, payments and history stay where they are.
um.merge_ack: I checked that both accounts belong to the same person.
um.perm_users_edit: Edit profile basics, tags and e-mails
um.needs_update: This needs the prepared database update.
um.request_created: Request created. A second super admin must approve it.
um.bulk_preview_first: You will see who is included before anything changes.
um.remind_hint: Consultants only. Anyone already done or reminded in the last 24 hours is skipped.
um.skip_policy: service policy not set up yet
um.undo_window: You can undo tags and suspensions for 10 minutes.
um.invite_many_desc: Paste e-mails (one per line) or upload a CSV: email, name, role, language. Up to {{n}} per run.
um.invites_suppressed: {{n}} not sent: e-mails to these addresses are blocked.
um.invites_limited: {{n}} not sent: hourly limit reached. Try again later.
um.needs_update_long: This part works once the prepared database update for user management is applied.
um.access_review_desc: Everyone with admin access, when they last signed in and what they can do here. Review this regularly.
um.revoke_desc: Admin and super admin roles are removed. Client or consultant roles stay. Super admins are alerted.
um.role_matrix_desc: Account roles are fixed. A person can hold several roles.
um.admin_groups_desc: Limit what an admin can do in this Users console. Admins in no group keep every admin permission; super admins always have everything.
um.no_groups: No admin groups yet, so every admin has full admin permissions.
um.view_as_desc: Preview which actions this console allows for a role or group.
um.other_pages_note: Other admin pages still follow the admin role.
um.four_eyes: Second approval for new super admins
um.four_eyes_desc: When on, granting super admin creates a request that another super admin must approve within 7 days.
um.security_alerts_desc: Notify super admins (in the app and by e-mail when administrator e-mails are on) about admin role changes and admin sign-ins from new devices.
um.group_dialog_desc: Members can only do what is ticked here in the Users console. Super-admin-only actions cannot be granted.

um.m_grant_admin: Grant or remove admin and super admin
um.m_groups: Manage admin groups and security settings
um.m_merge: Merge accounts, reset two-step sign-in, anonymise
um.admin_history_desc: Who did what to which account, with the reason and the values before and after.
um.search_placeholder: Search name, e-mail, company, phone or ID…
um.filters_desc: Combine any filters. The address updates so you can share the view.

um.first_200: The first {{n}} matching people are selected.

um.empty_desc: Try fewer filters or a different search.

npause.save_failed: Your pause could not be saved.
npause.title: Pause notifications
npause.dialog_desc: Take a break from reminders and updates. The pause ends by itself and we tell you when your notifications are back.
npause.ch_inapp_hint: Notices are still kept quietly in the bell, without pop-ups or sound.
npause.hold: Also hold in-app notices until the pause ends
npause.pick_one: Choose at least one channel and one kind of notice.
npause.unavailable: Also mark me unavailable for new requests during this period (recommended)
npause.unavailable_hint: Requests that arrive while you are unavailable do not count in your responsiveness statistics.
npause.stay_available: You stay available: new requests still reach you and count in your responsiveness statistics as usual.
npause.always: Always delivered: security and sign-in, password reset, payments, invoices and payouts, legal and policy notices, NDA and rate confirmations, account notices, Critical alarms and the first notice of every new assignment request.
npause.not_ready: Pausing notifications will be available after the next platform update.
npause.disabled: Pausing notifications is currently switched off.
npause.card_hint: Too many reminders? Pause e-mails and pop-ups for a while. Important messages such as security, payments and Critical alarms always arrive.
npause.err_invalid: This link is not valid. Please use the newest e-mail, or sign in and pause notifications in your settings.
npause.err_expired: This link has expired. Sign in and pause notifications in your settings.
npause.err_too_many: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
npause.err_unavailable: This is not available right now. Please try again later.
npause.page_error: We could not change your notifications
npause.page_paused_desc: Reminders, digests and activity e-mails are paused until then. Security, payment, legal and policy messages, Critical alarms and new assignment requests still arrive. The pause ends by itself.
npause.page_resumed_desc: You will receive e-mails and alerts as usual again.
npause.page_unsub_desc: You will no longer receive notification e-mails from AI Support 360 at this address.
npause.page_settings: Sign in to change your settings
npause.admin_not_ready: Available after the prepared database update for pausing notifications is applied.
npause.admin_switch_hint: Off: nobody can start a pause and current pauses stop holding notices. Essential notices are never paused.
npause.admin_count: {{n}} people have paused notifications right now ({{e}} e-mails, {{a}} in-app; {{u}} consultants marked unavailable).

bmsg.choose_category_first: Choose service or marketing first: it decides who is excluded.
bmsg.no_emails: Paste at least one e-mail address.
bmsg.write_first: Write a subject and a message first.
bmsg.secret_block: Remove the password or key first.
bmsg.off_desc: A super admin switched off sending in the settings. You can still prepare a message.
bmsg.audience_hint: Existing accounts only. Suspended and deleted accounts never receive messages.
bmsg.service_hint: Only about accounts or the service (changes, outages, required steps). Delivered even to people who paused notifications.
bmsg.marketing_hint: Skips people who paused notifications or unsubscribed from e-mails.
bmsg.users_hint: {{n}} people selected on the Users page.
bmsg.no_saved: No saved audiences yet. Save a filter or group first.
bmsg.group_hint: Sends to the consultants in that client group. The client is not told.
bmsg.save_group: Save this group as an audience
bmsg.emails_hint: {{n}} addresses recognised. Addresses without an account are ignored and only counted.
bmsg.unknown_emails: {{n}} addresses have no account and were ignored.
bmsg.message_hint: Everyone gets their own language. Write Arabic text too, or Arabic speakers get the English text. No attachments: use links.
bmsg.link_label: Link for {{link}} (a page of this site)
bmsg.link_bad: Use a page of www.aisupport360.com, for example /consultant/profile.
bmsg.secret_title: This looks like a password or key
bmsg.secret_desc: Never send passwords, keys or tokens. Remove them to continue.
bmsg.risk_email: The text contains an e-mail address.
bmsg.risk_phone: The text contains a phone number.
bmsg.risk_chat: The text links to WhatsApp or Telegram.
bmsg.risk_payment: The text mentions payment or bank details. We never ask users to pay outside the platform.
bmsg.risk_external: The text links to another website.
bmsg.ch_inapp_hint: Appears in the bell and under "Messages from AI Support 360". Up to {{n}} per minute.
bmsg.ch_popup_hint: Also shows the message once in a window until it is read.
bmsg.ch_telegram_n: {{n}} of the audience linked Telegram; others are skipped. Plain text and one link, about {{r}} per minute.
bmsg.ch_telegram_hint: Only people who linked Telegram. Plain text and one link.
bmsg.ch_email_hint: The app e-mail service only sends personal e-mails triggered by one event (receipts, reminders). Messages to many people need a separate newsletter service, so e-mail is not offered here.
bmsg.ch_whatsapp_hint: After saving you get a list with an "Open WhatsApp" button per person that opens your own WhatsApp with the text filled in.
bmsg.ch_sms_hint: Same list with an "Open SMS" button that opens your phone's messages app.
bmsg.ch_paid_hint: There is no free official automatic channel. A paid provider (charged per message) can be added once the owner chooses one.
bmsg.utc_is: That is {{when}} in your browser time.
bmsg.time_bad: Choose a time in the next 90 days.
bmsg.ack_service: I confirm this is a service notice about accounts or the service, not news or offers. Service notices reach people who paused notifications.
bmsg.ack_marketing: I confirm this is news or an offer. People who paused notifications or unsubscribed are left out.
bmsg.type_count: Type {{n}} to confirm the number of recipients
bmsg.ar_fallback: No Arabic text: English is sent
bmsg.no_tracking: No tracking pixels are used: "Read" means the person opened the notification in the app.
bmsg.cancel_desc: Nobody else will get it. People who already got it keep it.
bmsg.manual_title: Send by WhatsApp or SMS yourself
bmsg.manual_desc: Each button opens your own app with the text filled in. Tick a person once you have sent it. Numbers are for admins only; opening this list is recorded.
bmsg.set_ro: Only super admins can change these settings.
bmsg.set_enabled_hint: Turning this off stops everything that has not gone out yet, at once.
bmsg.set_email_hint: The app e-mail service sends only personal, event-based e-mails. For newsletters use a separate newsletter service.
bmsg.set_paid_hint: Paid per message. Nothing is sent automatically until the owner chooses a provider; the secret names it will need are:
bmsg.set_pause_on: Notification pauses are respected for news and offers.
bmsg.set_pause_off: Notification pauses are not set up yet, so only unsubscribed addresses are left out of news and offers.
bmsg.set_consent: There is no separate marketing consent setting today; unsubscribes and pauses are what count.
bmsg.title: Messages / Campaigns
bmsg.subtitle: Send one message to many users in the app, on Telegram, or by WhatsApp / SMS from your own phone.
bmsg.not_installed: Bulk messages are ready but switch on after the next database update. Nothing can be sent until then.
bmsg.denied: You do not have the "Send bulk messages" permission. A super admin can give it to you through an admin group.
bmsg.no_templates: No templates yet. Use "Save as template" while writing a message.
bmsg.r_missing: This message is no longer available.
